parameters.content:
## READ THIS

The Golden Error Handler (geh) workflow looks huge, but the setup takes 2 minutes and it's very straight forward.

#### Here's the 3 steps you need to do:
1. Setup the Gmail, Gemini, and n8n API credentials (see red sticky notes)
2. Press the execute manual trigger
3. Publish the workflow

#### Then, just go to the "Config Page Webhook" node and open the production url!

You can then configure everything from that dashboard.

It should look something like: https://n8n.example.com/webhook/geh-config

Everything else is good to go! If in doubt, you can simply go to the 'Guide' page from the Golden Error Handler's dashboard

## Endpoint Protection

Public endpoints: anyone with these URLs can view activity, change settings, connect workflows, or send test alerts.

**Before sharing, protect every Webhook node with _Authentication > Basic Auth_ and use the same credential, or require sign-in at your reverse proxy.**

Email actions will then prompt for sign-in.

Golden Error Handler
SettingsConnectActivityGuide

Workflow Guide

Architecture, pipeline stages, and integration reference for operators.

Stage 1

Ingest & Guard

Triggers on errors from any connected workflow. Guards validate payload integrity and prevent self-referential error loops.

Stage 2

Fingerprint & Deduplication

Normalizes error messages by masking timestamps, UUIDs, and numbers. Computes a stable SHA-256 fingerprint to track recurrence.

Stage 3

Severity & Exponential Backoff

Escalates severity based on recurrence (Low, Medium, High). Applies exponential pacing per error signature. Allowance resets after 24 hours of quiet.

Stage 4

Gemini AI Diagnostics

Gemini analyzes the failure context to hypothesize likely root causes and recommended next steps in plain language.

Stage 5

Multi-Channel Notification

Delivers structured alerts to Gmail (enabled by default), with optional Telegram, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and HTTP Webhook channels (disabled by default on canvas), including direct actions to open, retry, or mute.

Stage 6

Operator Actions & Self-Healing

Operators can mute recurring errors for 1h, 24h, 7d, or forever, or retry failed executions directly with a single click.

Test Console

Trigger a simulated error

Test the alerting and diagnostic pipeline using built-in error scenarios.

Reference

Trigger via Webhook / cURL

You can also invoke the error handler simulation via HTTP GET:

curl -X GET "

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Which notification channels are enabled by default?

Only Gmail is enabled by default in the base template. Slack, Discord, Telegram, Microsoft Teams, and HTTP Webhook are all disabled by default on the workflow canvas.

How do I set up Slack, Discord, Telegram, Microsoft Teams, or Webhooks?

Follow these three steps:

  1. Enable the corresponding channel node on the workflow canvas.
  2. Configure the node credentials in n8n.
  3. Go to Settings (/geh-config) to toggle the channel on and enter your channel ID, chat ID, or Webhook URL.

What public endpoints are provided?

/geh-config, /geh-assign, /geh-activity, /geh-guide, plus webhooks for mutes, retries, error simulation, and disconnects.

parameters.content:
## Activity Dashboard

Track real-time error telemetry and failure rates. View incident history and trigger execution retries with one click at /geh-activity.

## Workflow Guide

Comprehensive operator documentation, architecture walkthrough, quick links, and simulated error generator at /geh-guide.

## Hosted Config UI

Open the production webhook URL for /geh-config in your browser to tune notification thresholds, recipient email, Telegram channel, and alert pacing anytime without touching the canvas.

## Bulk Assignment

Visit /geh-assign to view your workflows and attach the Golden Error Handler to them in one click. It uses your native n8n API credential to update their settings safely.

## Safety Limits & Retention

High-volume queries cap at 10,000 records to protect workflow execution. If limits are reached, totals show an incomplete count indicator. Scheduled retention checks run daily and delete incidents older than your configured duration. Retention defaults to Never until explicitly chosen.

## Error Trigger & Guard

Catches unhandled errors from connected workflows. A payload guard validates incoming execution data and prevents self-referential error loops.

## Multi-Channel Alert

Alerts route to Gmail, Telegram, Teams, or Webhook with links to retry or mute. Native Slack, Discord, and Teams nodes are ready on canvas.

## Security & Actions

Action webhooks let you retry executions or mute recurring alerts directly from notifications or the dashboard without opening n8n.
